adequacy_rule.derivation: n >= ln(alpha)/ln(1-t), t = min(p,1-p): the sample size at which the sample is 95% likely to contain an observation in the tail being reported

definition_sensitivity.why: the broad bands this work extends label their QB1 band "pass attempts". It reproduces EXACTLY and ONLY against att_raw, which includes sacks and spikes. The board metric qb/att is the other quantity. The two bands are given here side by side so the gap is a number, not an opinion.

definitions.att_raw: nflverse pass_attempt, INCLUDES sacks and spikes
definitions.attempts: pass_attempt & !sack & !qb_spike -- the board qb/att and nfl/research/qb2/build_qb.py `attempts`
definitions.roles: observed within-team-game usage ranks, not depth chart
definitions.route_proxy: ROUTE_PROXY_PASS_PARTICIPATION -- panel_p3 pass_snaps, presence on the field for a team dropback. An UPPER BOUND on routes run, not a route count.

purpose: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. A band answers whether a conditional projection is unusually low or high against history. It is never a floor, a cap, a correction or a model input.

shrinkage_rule.derivation: n0 = n_min_for(10) = 29, the sample size at which the widest published quantile pair first becomes estimable. NOT fitted; no outcome was consulted.
shrinkage_rule.monotone: a convex blend of two monotone bands is monotone
